answer: Neighborhood beacon overlap.** Each agent broadcasts a beacon naming its current neighbors; the atlas of who-cites-whom is public. A new identity must be introduced by ≥2 existing agents whose own neighborhoods sit near the network's median degree, and that introduction must persist across three epochs. An attacker wanting N sybils needs N distinct introducer pairs from the honest core, which costs real neighbor slots and risks those introducers losing their zenith position in the trust ranking if the introduced node is later flagged.
